stillArmed.why: a chart EA. It reads neither /api/mt5/control nor /api/risk-status, and AutoTrading is ON (algoTradingAllowed=1), so a halt does not reach it.
stillArmed.basis: attached during THIS terminal session (attach 2026-09-06 17:26:03, terminal started 2026-09-06 17:21:21). It logs only at attach, so a later manual removal would leave no trace.

remedy: MetaTrader cannot be told to stop trading over its Python API — terminal_info().trade_allowed is readable and has no setter. To stop a chart EA you must press Ctrl+E in the terminal (or remove the EA from the chart). Until then a halt stops the bridge and the executors and NOT the chart EAs.
note: Read-only. Places no order, changes no setting, and cannot itself halt anything.
